review.note: 2026-11-05 h2h-dev-tools 0.12.0 dependency review. Direct dependencies, bounds and Python >=3.14 remain unchanged. Fresh official PyPI/npm metadata reports hatchling 1.33.0, distlib 0.4.4, packaging 26.3, build 1.6.1, mypy 2.4.1, pytest 9.2.0, pytest-xdist 3.8.0, ruff 0.17.3 and markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0; all stable releases satisfy existing lower-only bounds, with no out-of-bound stable candidate. Declared Python requirements admit 3.14; distlib has no Requires-Python field, which is not execution evidence. markdownlint-cli2 requires Node >=22. Reviewed upstream notes for Python 3.15 additions, launcher/archive hardening, packaging marker/specifier fixes, build's Windows symlink regression fix, mypy overload fixes, pytest plugin-error/cache changes, xdist loadscope controls and Ruff f-string/default changes. No concrete latest-release incompatibility requiring a new bound was identified. Existing explicit Ruff py314/rule settings and canonical source-authority/xdist regressions remain applicable. This metadata/release-note review does not claim new dependency installation, test execution or native Windows validation. Separately, the accepted normal/diagnostic lifetime author set passed 285 tests under Python 3.14.8 and existing local dependencies; final current-environment fast/full/artifact gates remain required.
